title: Part 5 Ask this take answer (simon.ask.v1)
description: The answer of `POST api/ask` and `part5 ask` (docs/specs/ask-this-take.md, TICKET-081): one question about one analysed take, answered by muse-wonder-1.0 with tools that read only that take, or by the measured facts. Every number in `answer` is a number of a `tool_calls[].result`, within its rounding. `ui_actions` are for the player to apply in order; the server never acts on them. The request a caller sends is `$defs.request`. With `stream: true` the route answers text/event-stream: `tool_call` events (a `$defs.tool_call`), `ui_action` events (a `$defs.ui_action`), then one `answer` event holding this document. Part 5 has no users: refusing a question about another user's take is Part 7's job ownership. Extra fields are allowed.

answer.description: One paragraph in plain English. The model's own words only when `source` is `model` (or `cache`); otherwise the measured facts.

model.description: muse-wonder-1.0 when a model call was made for this question or the cached answer came from one, else null. The models-used panel lists it.

live.description: True when at least one model call was sent for this question.

validated.description: True only when `answer` is the model's own words and every number in it was found in a tool result of the exchange.

replaced_numbers.description: The numbers of the model's answer that no tool result held, when the answer was replaced for that reason.

fallback_reason.description: Null when `source` is `model`; otherwise why the model's answer is not shown. Never the key or the model's text.

by.description: Present when Part 5 made the call itself for the measured facts.

t.description: Seconds on the take's own clock (the clock of faults[].at_s).
